# Verb + 咗 + … 未？ / 未 + Verb · *Verb + zo2 + … mei6? / mei6 + Verb*

**Meaning:** …yet? / not yet · **Level:** A2 · **Topic:** Time and aspect

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fmei6-yet).

Put 未 at the end of a 咗 sentence to ask 'yet?'. Answer …咗喇 (yes, already) or 未呀 (not yet). Before a verb, 未 means 'haven't yet'. 食咗飯未呀？ is also an everyday greeting.

**Written Chinese:** …了沒有？ / 還沒 — Written Chinese uses 了沒有 and 還沒.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你食咗飯未呀？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3? |
| Yale | néih sihk jó faahn meih a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄙㄧㆶ⁶ ㄗㄛ² ㄈㄚㄣ⁶ ㄇㄝㄧ⁶ ㄚ³? |
| English | Have you eaten yet? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢到咗未呀？** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 dou3 zo2 mei6 aa3? |
| Yale | kéuih dou jó meih a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄉㄛㄨ³ ㄗㄛ² ㄇㄝㄧ⁶ ㄚ³? |
| English | Has he arrived yet? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我未食。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 mei6 sik6. |
| Yale | ngóh meih sihk. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄇㄝㄧ⁶ ㄙㄧㆶ⁶. |
| English | I haven't eaten yet. |
